description: This Java class defines a condition that checks whether the Mifos Standard Loan Repayment Schedule Transaction Processor is enabled in the Fineract properties. It extends PropertiesCondition and overrides the matches method to perform this check.

classes.name: MifosStandardLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition
classes.description: A condition class that determines if the Mifos Standard Loan Repayment Schedule Transaction Processor is enabled based on the application's properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the matches method to return true if the Mifos Standard transaction processor is enabled in the properties.
